links.outcome: Complication detection across successive algorithm adjustment phases after interim analyses
links.effect: Ability to detect complications increased with each adjustment phase; final phase sensitivity 75%, specificity 83%, accuracy 82%, PPV 27%, NPV 97%.
links.quote: The ability to detect complications increased with each adjustment phase, and after the third and last phase, the digital solution identified 3(4.8%) real complications, with a sensitivity of 75%, specificity of 83%, accuracy of 82%, positive predictive value of 27%, and negative predictive value of 97%.

links.outcome: Chatbot detection of postoperative complications and ED referral, missed and unnecessary escalations
links.effect: Final phase sensitivity 75% (one of four real complications missed), specificity 83%, PPV 27%, NPV 97%, implying many unnecessary alerts.

unlisted_practices: Remote post-discharge symptom monitoring via chatbot after surgery
Specialist validation of algorithm changes after each interim analysis

screen.reason: The study deployed an AI-driven chatbot (using NLP and an algorithm) to monitor post-discharge colorectal surgery patients in real clinical care, evaluating clinical outcomes, adherence, and the impact of iterative specialist validation and algorithm adjustment across three interim phases.

primary.practice: iterative specialist review and interim adjustment of clinical triage algorithm
